content:
我要做一个工地出场车辆洗轮与泥污复查系统。门岗每天要核对出场车辆是否洗净，同一辆车多次出场时，每次都需要留下当次检查依据。

检查人员在每张出场单中上传车轮和车身照片，记录检查结果。不合格的车辆返回洗轮区，复洗后在原单上增加一轮检查。门岗页面按检查顺序展示照片与结论，只有本次最后一轮检查合格，才允许发送闸机放行指令，不能使用以前出场的照片代替。

初次不合格照片和后续复洗记录都要保留。车牌识别失败时允许人工登记，同时保存原识别结果。人工放行需要有权限的值班员确认并填写原因，普通录入人员不能直接放行。

后端使用 PHP 和 Laravel，前端采用 React，数据通过 Eloquent 存入 SQLite。车牌识别和闸机接口在本地模拟，照片保存到本地，提供一条本地命令启动前后端。请重点检查复洗仍不合格、引用旧照片以及无权限人工放行时，系统能否正确阻止出场。

addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. attachment.content:
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Laravel\Sanctum\HasApiTokens;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

class User extends Authenticatable
{
    use HasApiTokens, Notifiable;

    public const ROLE_CLERK = 'clerk';           // 普通录入/检查人员
    public const ROLE_SUPERVISOR = 'supervisor'; // 值班员（可人工放行）

    protected $fillable = [
        'name',
        'email',
        'password',
        'role',
    ];

    protected $hidden = [
        'password',
        'remember_token',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'email_verified_at' => 'datetime',
            'password' => 'hashed',
        ];
    }

    public function isSupervisor(): bool
    {
        return $this->role === self::ROLE_SUPERVISOR;
    }

    public function gatePassesCreated(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(GatePass::class, 'created_by');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;

class GatePass extends Model
{
    public const STATUS_PENDING = 'pending';   // 检查中/已退回复洗
    public const STATUS_PASSED = 'passed';     // 最后一轮检查合格，待放行
    public const STATUS_RELEASED = 'released'; // 闸机已放行

    protected $fillable = [
        'plate_number',
        'recognition_status',
        'recognized_text',
        'recognition_confidence',
        'recognition_raw',
        'manual_plate_number',
        'manual_entered_by',
        'driver_name',
        'remark',
        'status',
        'created_by',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'recognition_raw' => 'array',
        'recognition_confidence' => 'decimal:2',
    ];

    public function inspections(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Inspection::class)->orderBy('round');
    }

    public function latestInspection(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(Inspection::class)->latestOfMany('round');
    }

    public function release(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(GateRelease::class);
    }

    public function creator(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'created_by');
    }

    public function manualOperator(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'manual_entered_by');
    }

    public function effectivePlate(): ?string
    {
        return $this->plate_number ?? $this->manual_plate_number ?? $this->recognized_text;
    }

    /**
     * 只有本次出场单的最后一轮检查结论为合格时才允许放行。
     * 历史出场单的合格结论不参与本单判定。
     */
    public function latestRoundQualified(): bool
    {
        $latest = $this->inspections()->sortByDesc('round')->first();

        return $latest !== null && $latest->result === Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

/**
 * 车牌识别（LPR）本地模拟。
 *
 * 真实部署中这里会调用现场相机/识别盒子 SDK；当前环境用确定性伪识别代替：
 * - 识别成功：从识别原图的 sha256 派生一个稳定的车牌号（同一张图永远识别成同一车牌）；
 * - 识别失败：调用方显式要求模拟失败，或上传文件名带 FAIL 标记时，返回失败结果，
 *   原始返回内容仍会原样落库，便于事后追溯，不允许被人工登记覆盖。
 */
class LprService
{
    private const PROVINCES = ['京', '津', '冀', '晋', '蒙', '辽', '吉', '黑', '沪', '苏', '浙', '皖', '闽', '赣', '鲁', '豫', '鄂', '湘', '粤', '川'];
    private const LETTERS = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    private const ALNUM = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789';

    public function recognize(?string $imagePath, ?string $originalName = null, bool $forceFailure = false): array
    {
        $requestId = 'LPR-' . strtoupper(bin2hex(random_bytes(6)));
        $simulated = true;

        if ($forceFailure || ($originalName !== null && str_contains(strtoupper($originalName), 'FAIL'))) {
            return [
                'status' => 'failed',
                'plate' => null,
                'confidence' => null,
                'raw' => [
                    'simulated' => $simulated,
                    'request_id' => $requestId,
                    'return_code' => 'E_PLATE_NOT_FOUND',
                    'message' => '未检测到清晰车牌（模拟识别失败）',
                    'image_sha256' => $imagePath ? hash_file('sha256', $imagePath) : null,
                ],
            ];
        }

        $hash = $imagePath ? hash_file('sha256', $imagePath) : bin2hex(random_bytes(32));

        // 用哈希各字节派生车牌，保证同一图片识别结果稳定
        $pick = function (int $offset, string $alphabet) use ($hash) {
            return $alphabet[hexdec(substr($hash, $offset * 2, 2)) % strlen($alphabet)];
        };

        $plate = self::PROVINCES[hexdec(substr($hash, 0, 2)) % count(self::PROVINCES)]
            . $pick(1, self::LETTERS)
            . $pick(2, self::ALNUM)
            . $pick(3, self::ALNUM)
            . $pick(4, self::ALNUM)
            . $pick(5, self::ALNUM)
            . $pick(6, self::ALNUM);

        $confidence = 88.0 + (hexdec(substr($hash, 14, 2)) % 1200) / 100; // 88.00 - 99.99

        return [
            'status' => 'success',
            'plate' => $plate,
            'confidence' => round($confidence, 2),
            'raw' => [
                'simulated' => $simulated,
                'request_id' => $requestId,
                'return_code' => 'OK',
                'engine' => 'fake-lpr/1.0',
                'image_sha256' => $hash,
            ],
        ];
    }
}

        ];

        return [
            'command_id' => $commandId,
            'code' => 'OK',
            'raw' => $response,
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Exceptions\GatePassRuleException;
use App\Models\GatePass;
use App\Models\GateRelease;
use App\Models\Inspection;
use App\Models\InspectionPhoto;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class GatePassService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly LprService $lpr,
        private readonly GateService $gate,
    ) {}

    /**
     * 登记一张新的出场单并调用本地车牌识别。
     * 识别结果（成功或失败）原样留存；识别失败时可同时/事后人工登记车牌。
     */
    public function createPass(
        User $operator,
        ?UploadedFile $lprImage,
        bool $simulateRecognitionFailure,
        ?string $manualPlate,
        ?string $driverName,
        ?string $remark,
    ): GatePass {
        $recognition = $this->lpr->recognize(
            $lprImage?->getPathname(),
            $lprImage?->getClientOriginalName(),
            $simulateRecognitionFailure,
        );

        $failed = $recognition['status'] === 'failed';

        if (! $failed && $manualPlate !== null && trim($manualPlate) !== '') {
            // 识别成功时不需要人工登记，避免混淆
            $manualPlate = null;
        }

        return GatePass::create([
            'plate_number' => $failed ? null : $recognition['plate'],
            'recognition_status' => $recognition['status'],
            'recognized_text' => $recognition['plate'],
            'recognition_confidence' => $recognition['confidence'],
            'recognition_raw' => $recognition['raw'],
            'manual_plate_number' => $failed ? $this->normalizePlate($manualPlate) : null,
            'manual_entered_by' => ($failed && $manualPlate) ? $operator->id : null,
            'driver_name' => $driverName,
            'remark' => $remark,
            'status' => GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            'created_by' => $operator->id,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * 识别失败后补录车牌。原始识别结果始终保留，不做任何覆盖。
     */
    public function registerManualPlate(User $operator, GatePass $pass, string $plate): GatePass
    {
        if ($pass->recognition_status !== 'failed') {

        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单已放行，不能再修改车牌', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        $pass->update([
            'manual_plate_number' => $this->normalizePlate($plate),
            'manual_entered_by' => $operator->id,
        ]);

        return $pass->fresh();
    }

     * 在原出场单上增加一轮检查（初次检查 / 复洗后复查）。
     *
     * 每一轮都必须随请求重新上传当次拍摄的车轮、车身照片：

     */
    public function addInspection(
        User $inspector,
        GatePass $pass,
        string $result,
        ?string $finding,
        UploadedFile $wheelPhoto,
        UploadedFile $bodyPhoto,
    ): Inspection {
        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单已放行，不能再增加检查轮次', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

            ->get();

            throw new GatePassRuleException(
                '检测到上传的照片已在历史出场检查中使用，必须使用本次当场拍摄的照片',
                'PHOTO_ALREADY_USED',
            );
        }

            $inspection = $pass->inspections()->create([
                'round' => $round,
                'result' => $result,
                'finding' => $finding,
                'inspected_by' => $inspector->id,

            ]);

        });

    private function storePhoto(Inspection $inspection, string $viewType, UploadedFile $file, string $hash, User $uploader): void

        $directory = sprintf('inspection-photos/%d/round-%d', $inspection->gate_pass_id, $inspection->round);

            'inspection_id' => $inspection->id,
            'view_type' => $viewType,
            'file_path' => $path,
            'original_name' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
            'file_size' => $file->getSize(),
            'file_hash' => $hash,

     */

            throw new GatePassRuleException('该出场单已发送过放行指令，请勿重复放行', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');

        if ($type === GateRelease::TYPE_NORMAL) {
            if ($latest === null) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单尚无任何检查记录，不允许放行', 'NO_INSPECTION');
            }

                    "第 {$latest->round} 轮检查（最后一轮）结论为不合格，请退回洗轮区复洗后重新检查",

            if (! $operator->isSupervisor()) {

            }
            if ($latest === null) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单尚无任何检查记录，不允许人工放行', 'NO_INSPECTION');
            }
            if (trim((string) $reason) === '') {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('人工放行必须填写原因', 'MANUAL_REASON_REQUIRED');
            }
        } else {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('放行类型非法', 'INVALID_RELEASE_TYPE');
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($operator, $pass, $type, $reason, $latest) {
            $gate = $this->gate->open($pass);

            $release = GateRelease::create([
                'gate_pass_id' => $pass->id,
                'release_type' => $type,
                'released_by' => $operator->id,
                'reason' => $type === GateRelease::TYPE_MANUAL ? trim((string) $reason) : null,
                'gate_command_id' => $gate['command_id'],
                'gate_response_code' => $gate['code'],
                'gate_response_raw' => $gate['raw'],
                'released_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $pass->update(['status' => GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED]);

            return $release;
        });
    }

    private function normalizePlate(?string $plate): ?string
    {
        $plate = trim((string) $plate);

        return $plate === '' ? null : mb_strtoupper(str_replace([' ', '-'], '', $plate));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;

class GatePass extends Model
{
    public const STATUS_PENDING = 'pending';   // 检查中/已退回复洗
    public const STATUS_PASSED = 'passed';     // 最后一轮检查合格，待放行
    public const STATUS_RELEASED = 'released'; // 闸机已放行

    protected $fillable = [
        'plate_number',
        'recognition_status',
        'recognized_text',
        'recognition_confidence',
        'recognition_raw',
        'manual_plate_number',
        'manual_entered_by',
        'driver_name',
        'remark',
        'status',
        'created_by',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'recognition_raw' => 'array',
        'recognition_confidence' => 'decimal:2',
    ];

    public function inspections(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Inspection::class)->orderBy('round');
    }

    public function latestInspection(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(Inspection::class)->latestOfMany('round');
    }

    public function release(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(GateRelease::class);
    }

    public function creator(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'created_by');
    }

    public function manualOperator(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'manual_entered_by');
    }

    public function effectivePlate(): ?string
    {
        return $this->plate_number ?? $this->manual_plate_number ?? $this->recognized_text;
    }

    /**
     * 只有本次出场单的最后一轮检查结论为合格时才允许放行。
     * 历史出场单的合格结论不参与本单判定。
     */
    public function latestRoundQualified(): bool
    {
        $latest = $this->inspections()->sortByDesc('round')->first();

        return $latest !== null && $latest->result === Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED;
    }
}

        return $pass->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * 在原出场单上增加一轮检查（初次检查 / 复洗后复查）。
     *
     * 每一轮都必须随请求重新上传当次拍摄的车轮、车身照片：
     * - 系统不提供"引用历史照片"的入口；
     * - 服务端对文件 sha256 做全局唯一校验，任何与历史出场单或历史轮次字节相同的
     *   照片一律拒绝，防止用以前出场的照片顶替本次检查。
     */
    public function addInspection(
        User $inspector,
        GatePass $pass,
        string $result,
        ?string $finding,
        UploadedFile $wheelPhoto,
        UploadedFile $bodyPhoto,
    ): Inspection {
        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单已放行，不能再增加检查轮次', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        if (! in_array($result, [Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED, Inspection::RESULT_UNQUALIFIED], true)) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('检查结果取值非法', 'INVALID_RESULT');
        }

        $wheelHash = hash_file('sha256', $wheelPhoto->getPathname());
        $bodyHash = hash_file('sha256', $bodyPhoto->getPathname());

        if ($wheelHash === $bodyHash) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('车轮照片与车身照片不能是同一张图片', 'PHOTO_DUPLICATE_IN_ROUND');
        }

        $used = InspectionPhoto::whereIn('file_hash', [$wheelHash, $bodyHash])
            ->with('inspection:id,gate_pass_id,round')
            ->get();

        if ($used->isNotEmpty()) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException(
                '检测到上传的照片已在历史出场检查中使用，必须使用本次当场拍摄的照片',
                'PHOTO_ALREADY_USED',
            );
        }

        $round = ((int) $pass->inspections()->max('round')) + 1;

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($inspector, $pass, $result, $finding, $wheelPhoto, $bodyPhoto, $wheelHash, $bodyHash, $round) {
            $inspection = $pass->inspections()->create([
                'round' => $round,
                'result' => $result,
                'finding' => $finding,
                'inspected_by' => $inspector->id,
                'inspected_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $this->storePhoto($inspection, InspectionPhoto::VIEW_WHEEL, $wheelPhoto, $wheelHash, $inspector);
            $this->storePhoto($inspection, InspectionPhoto::VIEW_BODY, $bodyPhoto, $bodyHash, $inspector);

            // 只有最新一轮的结论决定出场单状态；以前轮次即使合格也不算数
            $pass->update([
                'status' => $result === Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED
                    ? GatePass::STATUS_PASSED
                    : GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            ]);

            return $inspection->load('photos', 'inspector:id,name');
        });
    }

    private function storePhoto(Inspection $inspection, string $viewType, UploadedFile $file, string $hash, User $uploader): void
    {
        $directory = sprintf('inspection-photos/%d/round-%d', $inspection->gate_pass_id, $inspection->round);
        $extension = $file->getClientOriginalExtension() ?: 'jpg';
        $name = sprintf('%s-%s.%s', $viewType, substr($hash, 0, 16), $extension);

        // 唯一索引兜底：并发请求同时通过前置查询时，这里会抛 QueryException
        try {
            $path = $file->storeAs($directory, $name, 'public');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException(
                '检测到上传的照片已在历史出场检查中使用，必须使用本次当场拍摄的照片',
                'PHOTO_ALREADY_USED',
            );
        }

        InspectionPhoto::create([
            'inspection_id' => $inspection->id,
            'view_type' => $viewType,
            'file_path' => $path,
            'original_name' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
            'file_size' => $file->getSize(),
            'file_hash' => $hash,
            'uploaded_by' => $uploader->id,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * 下发放行指令。
     *
     * 正常放行：本次出场单最后一轮检查必须合格（复洗后仍不合格直接拒绝）。
     * 人工放行：仅值班员可操作，且必须填写原因；普通录入人员抛出 403。
     */
    public function release(User $operator, GatePass $pass, string $type, ?string $reason): GateRelease
    {
        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('该出场单已发送过放行指令，请勿重复放行', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        $latest = $pass->inspections()->sortByDesc('round')->first();

        if ($type === GateRelease::TYPE_NORMAL) {
            if ($latest === null) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单尚无任何检查记录，不允许放行', 'NO_INSPECTION');
            }
            if ($latest->result !== Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException(
                    "第 {$latest->round} 轮检查（最后一轮）结论为不合格，请退回洗轮区复洗后重新检查",
                    'LATEST_ROUND_NOT_QUALIFIED',
                );
            }
        } elseif ($type === GateRelease::TYPE_MANUAL) {
            // 权限第一优先：普通录入人员拿不到人工放行入口，强行调用同样拒绝
            if (! $operator->isSupervisor()) {
                throw new AuthorizationException('只有值班员可以执行人工放行');
            }
            if ($latest === null) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单尚无任何检查记录，不允许人工放行', 'NO_INSPECTION');
            }
            if (trim((string) $reason) === '') {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('人工放行必须填写原因', 'MANUAL_REASON_REQUIRED');
            }
        } else {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('放行类型非法', 'INVALID_RELEASE_TYPE');
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($operator, $pass, $type, $reason, $latest) {
            $gate = $this->gate->open($pass);

            $release = GateRelease::create([
                'gate_pass_id' => $pass->id,
                'release_type' => $type,
                'released_by' => $operator->id,
                'reason' => $type === GateRelease::TYPE_MANUAL ? trim((string) $reason) : null,
                'gate_command_id' => $gate['command_id'],
                'gate_response_code' => $gate['code'],
                'gate_response_raw' => $gate['raw'],
                'released_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $pass->update(['status' => GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED]);

            return $release;
        });
    }

    private function normalizePlate(?string $plate): ?string
    {
        $plate = trim((string) $plate);

        return $plate === '' ? null : mb_strtoupper(str_replace([' ', '-'], '', $plate));
    }
}

            $lprImage?->getPathname(),
            $lprImage?->getClientOriginalName(),

        $failed = $recognition['status'] === 'failed';

        if (! $failed && $manualPlate !== null && trim($manualPlate) !== '') {

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    public function login(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'email' => ['required', 'email'],
            'password' => ['required', 'string'],
        ]);

        $user = User::where('email', $data['email'])->first();

        if (! $user || ! Hash::check($data['password'], $user->password)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'email' => ['账号或密码不正确'],
            ]);
        }

        $token = $user->createToken('gate-console')->plainTextToken;

        return response()->json([
            'token' => $token,
            'user' => [
                'id' => $user->id,
                'name' => $user->name,
                'email' => $user->email,
                'role' => $user->role,
                'is_supervisor' => $user->isSupervisor(),
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function me(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        return response()->json([
            'id' => $user->id,
            'name' => $user->name,
            'email' => $user->email,
            'role' => $user->role,
            'is_supervisor' => $user->isSupervisor(),
        ]);
    }
}

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    public function login(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'email' => ['required', 'email'],
            'password' => ['required', 'string'],
        ]);

        $user = User::where('email', $data['email'])->first();

        if (! $user || ! Hash::check($data['password'], $user->password)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'email' => ['账号或密码不正确'],
            ]);
        }

        $token = $user->createToken('gate-console')->plainTextToken;

        return response()->json([
            'token' => $token,
            'user' => [
                'id' => $user->id,
                'name' => $user->name,
                'email' => $user->email,
                'role' => $user->role,
                'is_supervisor' => $user->isSupervisor(),

        ]);

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\AddInspectionRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\ReleaseRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\StoreGatePassRequest;
use App\Http\Resources\GatePassResource;
use App\Http\Resources\InspectionResource;
use App\Models\GatePass;
use App\Services\GatePassService;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class GatePassController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(private readonly GatePassService $service) {}

    public function index(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $query = GatePass::query()
            ->with([
                'creator:id,name',
                'latestInspection',
                'release',
            ])
            ->withCount('inspections')
            ->latest('id');

        if ($status = $request->string('status')->toString()) {
            $query->where('status', $status);
        }

        return GatePassResource::collection($query->paginate(20))->response();
    }

    public function store(StoreGatePassRequest $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $pass = $this->service->createPass(
            operator: $request->user(),
            lprImage: $request->file('lpr_image'),
            simulateRecognitionFailure: $request->boolean('simulate_failure'),
            manualPlate: $request->input('manual_plate'),
            driverName: $request->input('driver_name'),
            remark: $request->input('remark'),
        );

        $pass->load('creator:id,name', 'inspections.photos', 'inspections.inspector:id,name');

        return (new GatePassResource($pass))
            ->response()
            ->setStatusCode(201);
    }

    public function show(GatePass $gatePass): JsonResponse
    {
        $gatePass->load([
            'creator:id,name',
            'manualOperator:id,name',
            'inspections.photos',
            'inspections.inspector:id,name',
            'release.operator:id,name',
        ]);

        return (new GatePassResource($gatePass))->response();
    }

    public function registerManualPlate(Request $request, GatePass $gatePass): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'manual_plate' => ['required', 'string', 'max:20'],
        ]);

        $pass = $this->service->registerManualPlate(
            $request->user(),
            $gatePass,
            $data['manual_plate'],
        );

        $pass->load('manualOperator:id,name');

        return (new GatePassResource($pass))->response();
    }

    public function addInspection(AddInspectionRequest $request, GatePass $gatePass): JsonResponse
    {
        $inspection = $this->service->addInspection(
            inspector: $request->user(),
            pass: $gatePass,
            result: $request->string('result')->toString(),
            finding: $request->input('finding'),
            wheelPhoto: $request->file('wheel_photo'),
            bodyPhoto: $request->file('body_photo'),
        );

        return (new InspectionResource($inspection))
            ->response()
            ->setStatusCode(201);
    }

    public function release(ReleaseRequest $request, GatePass $gatePass): JsonResponse
    {
        $release = $this->service->release(
            operator: $request->user(),
            pass: $gatePass,
            type: $request->string('type')->toString(),
            reason: $request->input('reason'),
        );

        $release->load('operator:id,name');

        return response()->json([
            'data' => [
                'release_type' => $release->release_type,
                'reason' => $release->reason,
                'released_at' => $release->released_at,
                'gate_command_id' => $release->gate_command_id,
                'gate_response_code' => $release->gate_response_code,
                'gate_response_raw' => $release->gate_response_raw,
                'operator' => [
                    'id' => $release->operator->id,
                    'name' => $release->operator->name,
                ],
            ],
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

use App\Exceptions\GatePassRuleException;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withRouting(
        web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
        api: __DIR__.'/../routes/api.php',
        commands: __DIR__.'/../routes/console.php',
        health: '/up',
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware): void {
        //
    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions): void {
        // 业务规则违反（最后一轮不合格、旧照片冒充等）统一 422 + 错误码
        $exceptions->render(function (GatePassRuleException $e, Request $request) {
            if ($request->is('api/*')) {
                return response()->json([
                    'message' => $e->getMessage(),
                    'error_code' => $e->errorCode,
                ], 422);
            }

            return null;
        });

        // 权限不足（如普通录入人员尝试人工放行）统一 403
        $exceptions->render(function (AuthorizationException $e, Request $request) {
            if ($request->is('api/*')) {
                return response()->json([
                    'message' => $e->getMessage() ?: '无操作权限',
                    'error_code' => 'FORBIDDEN',
                ], 403);
            }

            return null;
        });
    })->create();

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;

class GatePass extends Model
{
    public const STATUS_PENDING = 'pending';   // 检查中/已退回复洗
    public const STATUS_PASSED = 'passed';     // 最后一轮检查合格，待放行
    public const STATUS_RELEASED = 'released'; // 闸机已放行

    protected $fillable = [
        'plate_number',
        'recognition_status',
        'recognized_text',
        'recognition_confidence',
        'recognition_raw',
        'manual_plate_number',
        'manual_entered_by',
        'driver_name',
        'remark',
        'status',
        'created_by',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'recognition_raw' => 'array',
        'recognition_confidence' => 'decimal:2',
    ];

    public function inspections(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Inspection::class)->orderBy('round');
    }

    public function latestInspection(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(Inspection::class)->latestOfMany('round');
    }

    public function release(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(GateRelease::class);
    }

    public function creator(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'created_by');
    }

    public function manualOperator(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'manual_entered_by');
    }

    public function effectivePlate(): ?string
    {
        return $this->plate_number ?? $this->manual_plate_number ?? $this->recognized_text;
    }

    /**
     * 只有本次出场单的最后一轮检查结论为合格时才允许放行。
     * 历史出场单的合格结论不参与本单判定。
     */
    public function latestRoundQualified(): bool
    {
        $latest = $this->inspections()->orderByDesc('round')->first();

        return $latest !== null && $latest->result === Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Exceptions\GatePassRuleException;
use App\Models\GatePass;
use App\Models\GateRelease;
use App\Models\Inspection;
use App\Models\InspectionPhoto;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class GatePassService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly LprService $lpr,
        private readonly GateService $gate,
    ) {}

    /**
     * 登记一张新的出场单并调用本地车牌识别。
     * 识别结果（成功或失败）原样留存；识别失败时可同时/事后人工登记车牌。
     */
    public function createPass(
        User $operator,
        ?UploadedFile $lprImage,
        bool $simulateRecognitionFailure,
        ?string $manualPlate,
        ?string $driverName,
        ?string $remark,
    ): GatePass {
        $recognition = $this->lpr->recognize(
            $lprImage?->getPathname(),
            $lprImage?->getClientOriginalName(),
            $simulateRecognitionFailure,
        );

        $failed = $recognition['status'] === 'failed';

        if (! $failed && $manualPlate !== null && trim($manualPlate) !== '') {
            // 识别成功时不需要人工登记，避免混淆
            $manualPlate = null;
        }

        return GatePass::create([
            'plate_number' => $failed ? null : $recognition['plate'],
            'recognition_status' => $recognition['status'],
            'recognized_text' => $recognition['plate'],
            'recognition_confidence' => $recognition['confidence'],
            'recognition_raw' => $recognition['raw'],
            'manual_plate_number' => $failed ? $this->normalizePlate($manualPlate) : null,
            'manual_entered_by' => ($failed && $manualPlate) ? $operator->id : null,
            'driver_name' => $driverName,
            'remark' => $remark,
            'status' => GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            'created_by' => $operator->id,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * 识别失败后补录车牌。原始识别结果始终保留，不做任何覆盖。
     */
    public function registerManualPlate(User $operator, GatePass $pass, string $plate): GatePass
    {
        if ($pass->recognition_status !== 'failed') {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('车牌识别成功，无需人工登记', 'MANUAL_PLATE_NOT_ALLOWED');
        }

        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单已放行，不能再修改车牌', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        $pass->update([
            'manual_plate_number' => $this->normalizePlate($plate),
            'manual_entered_by' => $operator->id,
        ]);

        return $pass->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * 在原出场单上增加一轮检查（初次检查 / 复洗后复查）。
     *
     * 每一轮都必须随请求重新上传当次拍摄的车轮、车身照片：
     * - 系统不提供"引用历史照片"的入口；
     * - 服务端对文件 sha256 做全局唯一校验，任何与历史出场单或历史轮次字节相同的
     *   照片一律拒绝，防止用以前出场的照片顶替本次检查。
     */
    public function addInspection(
        User $inspector,
        GatePass $pass,
        string $result,
        ?string $finding,
        UploadedFile $wheelPhoto,
        UploadedFile $bodyPhoto,
    ): Inspection {
        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单已放行，不能再增加检查轮次', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        if (! in_array($result, [Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED, Inspection::RESULT_UNQUALIFIED], true)) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('检查结果取值非法', 'INVALID_RESULT');
        }

        $wheelHash = hash_file('sha256', $wheelPhoto->getPathname());
        $bodyHash = hash_file('sha256', $bodyPhoto->getPathname());

        if ($wheelHash === $bodyHash) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('车轮照片与车身照片不能是同一张图片', 'PHOTO_DUPLICATE_IN_ROUND');
        }

        $used = InspectionPhoto::whereIn('file_hash', [$wheelHash, $bodyHash])
            ->with('inspection:id,gate_pass_id,round')
            ->get();

        if ($used->isNotEmpty()) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException(
                '检测到上传的照片已在历史出场检查中使用，必须使用本次当场拍摄的照片',
                'PHOTO_ALREADY_USED',
            );
        }

        $round = ((int) $pass->inspections()->max('round')) + 1;

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($inspector, $pass, $result, $finding, $wheelPhoto, $bodyPhoto, $wheelHash, $bodyHash, $round) {
            $inspection = $pass->inspections()->create([
                'round' => $round,
                'result' => $result,
                'finding' => $finding,
                'inspected_by' => $inspector->id,
                'inspected_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $this->storePhoto($inspection, InspectionPhoto::VIEW_WHEEL, $wheelPhoto, $wheelHash, $inspector);
            $this->storePhoto($inspection, InspectionPhoto::VIEW_BODY, $bodyPhoto, $bodyHash, $inspector);

            // 只有最新一轮的结论决定出场单状态；以前轮次即使合格也不算数
            $pass->update([
                'status' => $result === Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED
                    ? GatePass::STATUS_PASSED
                    : GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            ]);

            return $inspection->load('photos', 'inspector:id,name');
        });
    }

    private function storePhoto(Inspection $inspection, string $viewType, UploadedFile $file, string $hash, User $uploader): void
    {
        $directory = sprintf('inspection-photos/%d/round-%d', $inspection->gate_pass_id, $inspection->round);
        $extension = $file->getClientOriginalExtension() ?: 'jpg';
        $name = sprintf('%s-%s.%s', $viewType, substr($hash, 0, 16), $extension);

        $path = $file->storeAs($directory, $name, 'public');

        // 唯一索引兜底：并发请求同时通过前置哈希查询时，INSERT 会在这里冲突
        try {
            InspectionPhoto::create([
                'inspection_id' => $inspection->id,
                'view_type' => $viewType,
                'file_path' => $path,
                'original_name' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                'file_size' => $file->getSize(),
                'file_hash' => $hash,
                'uploaded_by' => $uploader->id,
            ]);
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException(
                '检测到上传的照片已在历史出场检查中使用，必须使用本次当场拍摄的照片',
                'PHOTO_ALREADY_USED',
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * 下发放行指令。
     *
     * 正常放行：本次出场单最后一轮检查必须合格（复洗后仍不合格直接拒绝）。
     * 人工放行：仅值班员可操作，且必须填写原因；普通录入人员抛出 403。
     */
    public function release(User $operator, GatePass $pass, string $type, ?string $reason): GateRelease
    {
        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('该出场单已发送过放行指令，请勿重复放行', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        $latest = $pass->inspections()->orderByDesc('round')->first();

        if ($type === GateRelease::TYPE_NORMAL) {
            if ($latest === null) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单尚无任何检查记录，不允许放行', 'NO_INSPECTION');
            }
            if ($latest->result !== Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException(
                    "第 {$latest->round} 轮检查（最后一轮）结论为不合格，请退回洗轮区复洗后重新检查",
                    'LATEST_ROUND_NOT_QUALIFIED',
                );
            }
        } elseif ($type === GateRelease::TYPE_MANUAL) {
            // 权限第一优先：普通录入人员拿不到人工放行入口，强行调用同样拒绝
            if (! $operator->isSupervisor()) {
                throw new AuthorizationException('只有值班员可以执行人工放行');
            }
            if ($latest === null) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单尚无任何检查记录，不允许人工放行', 'NO_INSPECTION');
            }
            if (trim((string) $reason) === '') {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('人工放行必须填写原因', 'MANUAL_REASON_REQUIRED');
            }
        } else {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('放行类型非法', 'INVALID_RELEASE_TYPE');
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($operator, $pass, $type, $reason, $latest) {
            $gate = $this->gate->open($pass);

            $release = GateRelease::create([
                'gate_pass_id' => $pass->id,
                'release_type' => $type,
                'released_by' => $operator->id,
                'reason' => $type === GateRelease::TYPE_MANUAL ? trim((string) $reason) : null,
                'gate_command_id' => $gate['command_id'],
                'gate_response_code' => $gate['code'],
                'gate_response_raw' => $gate['raw'],
                'released_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $pass->update(['status' => GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED]);

            return $release;
        });
    }

    private function normalizePlate(?string $plate): ?string
    {
        $plate = trim((string) $plate);

        return $plate === '' ? null : mb_strtoupper(str_replace([' ', '-'], '', $plate));
    }
}

                throw new GatePassRuleException('人工放行必须填写原因', 'MANUAL_REASON_REQUIRED');
            }
        } else {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('放行类型非法', 'INVALID_RELEASE_TYPE');
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($operator, $pass, $type, $reason, $latest) {
            $gate = $this->gate->open($pass);

            $release = GateRelease::create([
                'gate_pass_id' => $pass->id,

        });
    }

    private function normalizePlate(?string $plate): ?string

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Exceptions\GatePassRuleException;
use App\Models\GatePass;
use App\Models\GateRelease;
use App\Models\Inspection;
use App\Models\InspectionPhoto;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\AccessDeniedHttpException;

class GatePassService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly LprService $lpr,
        private readonly GateService $gate,
    ) {}

    /**
     * 登记一张新的出场单并调用本地车牌识别。
     * 识别结果（成功或失败）原样留存；识别失败时可同时/事后人工登记车牌。
     */
    public function createPass(
        User $operator,
        ?UploadedFile $lprImage,
        bool $simulateRecognitionFailure,
        ?string $manualPlate,
        ?string $driverName,
        ?string $remark,
    ): GatePass {
        $recognition = $this->lpr->recognize(
            $lprImage?->getPathname(),
            $lprImage?->getClientOriginalName(),
            $simulateRecognitionFailure,
        );

        $failed = $recognition['status'] === 'failed';

        if (! $failed && $manualPlate !== null && trim($manualPlate) !== '') {
            // 识别成功时不需要人工登记，避免混淆
            $manualPlate = null;
        }

        return GatePass::create([
            'plate_number' => $failed ? null : $recognition['plate'],
            'recognition_status' => $recognition['status'],
            'recognized_text' => $recognition['plate'],
            'recognition_confidence' => $recognition['confidence'],
            'recognition_raw' => $recognition['raw'],
            'manual_plate_number' => $failed ? $this->normalizePlate($manualPlate) : null,
            'manual_entered_by' => ($failed && $manualPlate) ? $operator->id : null,
            'driver_name' => $driverName,
            'remark' => $remark,
            'status' => GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            'created_by' => $operator->id,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * 识别失败后补录车牌。原始识别结果始终保留，不做任何覆盖。
     */
    public function registerManualPlate(User $operator, GatePass $pass, string $plate): GatePass
    {
        if ($pass->recognition_status !== 'failed') {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('车牌识别成功，无需人工登记', 'MANUAL_PLATE_NOT_ALLOWED');
        }

        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单已放行，不能再修改车牌', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        $pass->update([
            'manual_plate_number' => $this->normalizePlate($plate),
            'manual_entered_by' => $operator->id,
        ]);

        return $pass->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * 在原出场单上增加一轮检查（初次检查 / 复洗后复查）。
     *
     * 每一轮都必须随请求重新上传当次拍摄的车轮、车身照片：
     * - 系统不提供"引用历史照片"的入口；
     * - 服务端对文件 sha256 做全局唯一校验，任何与历史出场单或历史轮次字节相同的
     *   照片一律拒绝，防止用以前出场的照片顶替本次检查。
     */
    public function addInspection(
        User $inspector,
        GatePass $pass,
        string $result,
        ?string $finding,
        UploadedFile $wheelPhoto,
        UploadedFile $bodyPhoto,
    ): Inspection {
        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单已放行，不能再增加检查轮次', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        if (! in_array($result, [Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED, Inspection::RESULT_UNQUALIFIED], true)) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('检查结果取值非法', 'INVALID_RESULT');
        }

        $wheelHash = hash_file('sha256', $wheelPhoto->getPathname());
        $bodyHash = hash_file('sha256', $bodyPhoto->getPathname());

        if ($wheelHash === $bodyHash) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('车轮照片与车身照片不能是同一张图片', 'PHOTO_DUPLICATE_IN_ROUND');
        }

        $used = InspectionPhoto::whereIn('file_hash', [$wheelHash, $bodyHash])
            ->with('inspection:id,gate_pass_id,round')
            ->get();

        if ($used->isNotEmpty()) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException(
                '检测到上传的照片已在历史出场检查中使用，必须使用本次当场拍摄的照片',
                'PHOTO_ALREADY_USED',
            );
        }

        $round = ((int) $pass->inspections()->max('round')) + 1;

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($inspector, $pass, $result, $finding, $wheelPhoto, $bodyPhoto, $wheelHash, $bodyHash, $round) {
            $inspection = $pass->inspections()->create([
                'round' => $round,
                'result' => $result,
                'finding' => $finding,
                'inspected_by' => $inspector->id,
                'inspected_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $this->storePhoto($inspection, InspectionPhoto::VIEW_WHEEL, $wheelPhoto, $wheelHash, $inspector);
            $this->storePhoto($inspection, InspectionPhoto::VIEW_BODY, $bodyPhoto, $bodyHash, $inspector);

            // 只有最新一轮的结论决定出场单状态；以前轮次即使合格也不算数
            $pass->update([
                'status' => $result === Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED
                    ? GatePass::STATUS_PASSED
                    : GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            ]);

            return $inspection->load('photos', 'inspector:id,name');
        });
    }

    private function storePhoto(Inspection $inspection, string $viewType, UploadedFile $file, string $hash, User $uploader): void
    {
        $directory = sprintf('inspection-photos/%d/round-%d', $inspection->gate_pass_id, $inspection->round);
        $extension = $file->getClientOriginalExtension() ?: 'jpg';
        $name = sprintf('%s-%s.%s', $viewType, substr($hash, 0, 16), $extension);

        $path = $file->storeAs($directory, $name, 'public');

        // 唯一索引兜底：并发请求同时通过前置哈希查询时，INSERT 会在这里冲突
        try {
            InspectionPhoto::create([
                'inspection_id' => $inspection->id,
                'view_type' => $viewType,
                'file_path' => $path,
                'original_name' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                'file_size' => $file->getSize(),
                'file_hash' => $hash,
                'uploaded_by' => $uploader->id,
            ]);
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException(
                '检测到上传的照片已在历史出场检查中使用，必须使用本次当场拍摄的照片',
                'PHOTO_ALREADY_USED',
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * 下发放行指令。
     *
     * 正常放行：本次出场单最后一轮检查必须合格（复洗后仍不合格直接拒绝）。
     * 人工放行：仅值班员可操作，且必须填写原因；普通录入人员抛出 403。
     */
    public function release(User $operator, GatePass $pass, string $type, ?string $reason): GateRelease
    {
        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('该出场单已发送过放行指令，请勿重复放行', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        $latest = $pass->inspections()->reorder()->orderByDesc('round')->first();

        if ($type === GateRelease::TYPE_NORMAL) {
            if ($latest === null) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单尚无任何检查记录，不允许放行', 'NO_INSPECTION');
            }
            if ($latest->result !== Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException(
                    "第 {$latest->round} 轮检查（最后一轮）结论为不合格，请退回洗轮区复洗后重新检查",
                    'LATEST_ROUND_NOT_QUALIFIED',
                );
            }
        } elseif ($type === GateRelease::TYPE_MANUAL) {
            // 权限第一优先：普通录入人员拿不到人工放行入口，强行调用同样拒绝
            if (! $operator->isSupervisor()) {
                throw new AuthorizationException('只有值班员可以执行人工放行');
            }
            if ($latest === null) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单尚无任何检查记录，不允许人工放行', 'NO_INSPECTION');
            }
            if (trim((string) $reason) === '') {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('人工放行必须填写原因', 'MANUAL_REASON_REQUIRED');
            }
        } else {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('放行类型非法', 'INVALID_RELEASE_TYPE');
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($operator, $pass, $type, $reason, $latest) {
            $gate = $this->gate->open($pass);

            $release = GateRelease::create([
                'gate_pass_id' => $pass->id,
                'release_type' => $type,
                'released_by' => $operator->id,
                'reason' => $type === GateRelease::TYPE_MANUAL ? trim((string) $reason) : null,
                'gate_command_id' => $gate['command_id'],
                'gate_response_code' => $gate['code'],
                'gate_response_raw' => $gate['raw'],
                'released_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $pass->update(['status' => GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED]);

            return $release;
        });
    }

    private function normalizePlate(?string $plate): ?string
    {
        $plate = trim((string) $plate);

        return $plate === '' ? null : mb_strtoupper(str_replace([' ', '-'], '', $plate));
    }
}

<?php

use App\Exceptions\GatePassRuleException;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withRouting(
        web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
        api: __DIR__.'/../routes/api.php',
        commands: __DIR__.'/../routes/console.php',
        health: '/up',
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware): void {
        //
    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions): void {
        // 业务规则违反（最后一轮不合格、旧照片冒充等）统一 422 + 错误码
        $exceptions->render(function (GatePassRuleException $e, Request $request) {
            if ($request->is('api/*')) {
                return response()->json([
                    'message' => $e->getMessage(),
                    'error_code' => $e->errorCode,
                ], 422);
            }

            return null;
        });

        // 权限不足（如普通录入人员尝试人工放行）统一 403
        $exceptions->render(function (AuthorizationException $e, Request $request) {
            if ($request->is('api/*')) {
                return response()->json([
                    'message' => $e->getMessage() ?: '无操作权限',
                    'error_code' => 'FORBIDDEN',
                ], 403);
            }

            return null;
        });
    })->create();

My bash function `j()` was broken: PHP `-r` with `$1` positional arg syntax is wrong. 

Further investigation into the repeated "HTTP:000" lines output by the j function has confirmed that the root cause is a parse error triggered when the j function runs PHP with arguments, leading to an empty token and the repeated curl requests.

After further troubleshooting of the repeated HTTP:000 issue, I've ruled out several potential causes including PHP parse errorstdin consumption and curl retry configurations. Given the numerous quirks in the bash environment, I've decided to rewrite the relevant smoke test script using Node.js, and I will start writing the corresponding Node script soon.

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\GatePass;
use App\Models\Inspection;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\Testing\File;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Tests\TestCase;

class GatePassFlowTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function png(string $name, int $r, int $g, int $b): File
    {
        $im = imagecreatetruecolor(80, 60);
        imagefilledrectangle($im, 0, 0, 80, 60, imagecolorallocate($im, $r, $g, $b));
        ob_start();
        imagepng($im);
        $data = ob_get_clean();
        imagedestroy($im);

        $tmp = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'png');
        file_put_contents($tmp, $data);

        return new File($name, fopen($tmp, 'r+'));
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Storage::fake('public');
    }

    public function test_recognized_pass_and_clerk_are_ready(): void
    {
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('users', 2); // 由 seeder 之外的工厂创建场景，见各用例
    }

    /**
     * 关键拦截 1：复洗后仍不合格，禁止放行；历史不合格记录与照片全程保留。
     */
    public function test_release_blocked_while_latest_round_unqualified(): void
    {
        $clerk = User::factory()->create(['role' => User::ROLE_CLERK]);
        $pass = GatePass::create([
            'plate_number' => '京A11111',
            'recognition_status' => 'success',
            'recognized_text' => '京A11111',
            'recognition_confidence' => 99.0,
            'status' => GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            'created_by' => $clerk->id,
        ]);

        // 第 1 轮：不合格
        $this->actingAs($clerk)->postJson("/api/gate-passes/{$pass->id}/inspections", [
            'result' => Inspection::RESULT_UNQUALIFIED,
            'finding' => '后轮带泥',
            'wheel_photo' => $this->png('w1.png', 10, 20, 30),
            'body_photo' => $this->png('b1.png', 40, 50, 60),
        ])->assertCreated();

        $this->postJson("/api/gate-passes/{$pass->id}/release", ['type' => 'normal'])
            ->assertStatus(422)
            ->assertJson(['error_code' => 'LATEST_ROUND_NOT_QUALIFIED']);

        // 第 2 轮（复洗后复查）：仍然不合格
        $this->postJson("/api/gate-passes/{$pass->id}/inspections", [
            'result' => Inspection::RESULT_UNQUALIFIED,
            'finding' => '侧面泥污未洗净',
            'wheel_photo' => $this->png('w2.png', 70, 80, 90),
            'body_photo' => $this->png('b2.png', 100, 110, 120),
        ])->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('data.round', 2);

        $this->postJson("/api/gate-passes/{$pass->id}/release", ['type' => 'normal'])
            ->assertStatus(422)
            ->assertJson(['error_code' => 'LATEST_ROUND_NOT_QUALIFIED']);

        // 闸机记录不得产生，出场单仍是检查中
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('gate_releases', 0);
        $this->assertSame(GatePass::STATUS_PENDING, $pass->fresh()->status);

        // 初次不合格照片与复洗记录都保留
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('inspections', 2);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('inspection_photos', 4);
    }

    /**
     * 关键拦截 2：任何历史轮次/历史出场单的照片都不能冒充当次检查依据。
     */
    public function test_reusing_old_photos_is_rejected(): void
    {
        $clerk = User::factory()->create(['role' => User::ROLE_CLERK]);

        $pass1 = GatePass::create([
            'plate_number' => '京A22222', 'recognition_status' => 'success',
            'recognized_text' => '京A22222', 'status' => GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            'created_by' => $clerk->id,
        ]);

        $wheel1 = $this->png('wheel.png', 1, 2, 3);
        $body1 = $this->png('body.png', 4, 5, 6);

        $this->actingAs($clerk)->postJson("/api/gate-passes/{$pass1->id}/inspections", [
            'result' => Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED,
            'wheel_photo' => $wheel1,
            'body_photo' => $body1,
        ])->assertCreated();

        // 同一车轮照片在同一出场单新一轮中重复使用 → 拒绝
        $this->postJson("/api/gate-passes/{$pass1->id}/inspections", [
            'result' => Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED,
            'wheel_photo' => $this->png('wheel.png', 1, 2, 3), // 字节与第一次完全相同
            'body_photo' => $this->png('body2.png', 9, 9, 9),
        ])->assertStatus(422)->assertJson(['error_code' => 'PHOTO_ALREADY_USED']);

        // 同一车辆再次出场（新出场单），引用上一次出场照片 → 拒绝
        $pass2 = GatePass::create([
            'plate_number' => '京A22222', 'recognition_status' => 'success',
            'recognized_text' => '京A22222', 'status' => GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            'created_by' => $clerk->id,
        ]);

        $this->postJson("/api/gate-passes/{$pass2->id}/inspections", [
            'result' => Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED,
            'wheel_photo' => $this->png('wheel.png', 1, 2, 3),
            'body_photo' => $this->png('body-other.png', 7, 8, 9),
        ])->assertStatus(422)->assertJson(['error_code' => 'PHOTO_ALREADY_USED']);

        // 被拒的检查轮次不得落库
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('inspections', 1);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('inspection_photos', 2);
    }

    /**
     * 关键拦截 3：普通录入人员不能人工放行；值班员也必须填写原因。
     */
    public function test_manual_release_requires_supervisor_and_reason(): void
    {
        $clerk = User::factory()->create(['role' => User::ROLE_CLERK]);
        $supervisor = User::factory()->create(['role' => User::ROLE_SUPERVISOR]);

        $pass = GatePass::create([
            'plate_number' => '京A33333', 'recognition_status' => 'success',
            'recognized_text' => '京A33333', 'status' => GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            'created_by' => $clerk->id,
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($clerk)->postJson("/api/gate-passes/{$pass->id}/inspections", [
            'result' => Inspection::RESULT_UNQUALIFIED,
            'wheel_photo' => $this->png('w.png', 1, 1, 1),
            'body_photo' => $this->png('b.png', 2, 2, 2),
        ])->assertCreated();

        // 普通录入人员强行调人工放行 → 403，闸机无指令
        $this->postJson("/api/gate-passes/{$pass->id}/release", [
            'type' => 'manual', 'reason' => '司机着急',
        ])->assertStatus(403)->assertJson(['error_code' => 'FORBIDDEN']);

        // 值班员未填原因 → 422
        $this->actingAs($supervisor)->postJson("/api/gate-passes/{$pass->id}/release", [
            'type' => 'manual', 'reason' => '   ',
        ])->assertStatus(422)->assertJson(['error_code' => 'MANUAL_REASON_REQUIRED']);

        $this->assertDatabaseCount('gate_releases', 0);
        $this->assertSame(GatePass::STATUS_PENDING, $pass->fresh()->status);

        // 值班员 + 原因 → 人工放行成功并记录原因
        $this->postJson("/api/gate-passes/{$pass->id}/release", [
            'type' => 'manual', 'reason' => '应急物资车辆，经现场负责人同意',
        ])->assertStatus(200)->assertJsonPath('data.release_type', 'manual');

        $this->assertSame(GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED, $pass->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_failed_recognition_keeps_raw_result_and_allows_manual_registration(): void
    {
        $clerk = User::factory()->create(['role' => User::ROLE_CLERK]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($clerk)->post('/api/gate-passes', [
            'simulate_failure' => '1',
            'manual_plate' => '京A99999',
        ])->assertCreated();

        $id = $response->json('data.id');
        $this->assertNull($response->json('data.plate_number'));
        $this->assertSame('failed', $response->json('data.recognition.status'));
        $this->assertSame('E_PLATE_NOT_FOUND', $response->json('data.recognition.raw.return_code'));
        $this->assertSame('京A99999', $response->json('data.manual_plate_number'));

        // 原识别结果不被覆盖
        $this->assertSame('failed', GatePass::find($id)->recognition_raw['return_code']);
    }
}

            'simulate_failure' => '1',
            'manual_plate' => '京A99999',

        $id = $response->json('data.id');
        $this->assertNull($response->json('data.plate_number'));
        $this->assertSame('failed', $response->json('data.recognition.status'));
        $this->assertSame('E_PLATE_NOT_FOUND', $response->json('data.recognition.raw.return_code'));
        $this->assertSame('京A99999', $response->json('data.manual_plate_number'));

        // 原识别结果不被覆盖
        $this->assertSame('failed', GatePass::find($id)->recognition_raw['return_code']);
    }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 本地一键启动：Laravel API(8000) + React/Vite 前端(5173)
# 用法：bin/dev.sh
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

# 选择 PHP：优先项目自带静态 PHP（无系统 PHP 的环境），其次系统 php
if [[ -x "$ROOT/.tools/php" ]]; then
  PHP="$ROOT/.tools/php"
else
  PHP="$(command -v php)"
fi
echo "使用 PHP：$($PHP -r 'echo PHP_VERSION;')"

# 依赖自检
if [[ ! -d vendor ]]; then
  echo "缺少 vendor，先执行 bin/setup.sh 安装后端依赖" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ ! -d frontend/node_modules ]]; then
  echo "缺少 frontend/node_modules，先执行 bin/setup.sh 安装前端依赖" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# 数据库与存储链接准备（幂等）
[[ -f database/database.sqlite ]] || : > database/database.sqlite
"$PHP" artisan migrate --force
"$PHP" artisan db:seed --force
[[ -e public/storage ]] || "$PHP" artisan storage:link

cleanup() {
  echo
  echo "正在停止前后端…"
  [[ -n "${BACK_PID:-}" ]] && kill "$BACK_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  [[ -n "${FRONT_PID:-}" ]] && kill "$FRONT_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

echo "启动后端 API：http://127.0.0.1:8000"
"$PHP" artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000 &
BACK_PID=$!

echo "启动前端页面：http://127.0.0.1:5173"
( cd frontend && npm run dev ) &
FRONT_PID=$!

echo
echo "================================================================"
echo " 门岗终端： http://127.0.0.1:5173"
echo " 演示账号： clerk@site.local      （普通检查人员）"
echo "           supervisor@site.local （值班员，可人工放行）"
echo " 密码均为： password"
echo " 按 Ctrl+C 停止全部服务"
echo "================================================================"

wait -n "$BACK_PID" "$FRONT_PID"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 首次环境准备：安装 PHP/Node 依赖、初始化 SQLite 数据库。
# 用法：bin/setup.sh
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

if [[ -x "$ROOT/.tools/php" ]]; then
  PHP="$ROOT/.tools/php"
  COMPOSER="$ROOT/.tools/composer"
else
  PHP="$(command -v php)"
  COMPOSER="$(command -v composer)"
fi
echo "PHP: $($PHP -v | head -1)"

command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "未找到 npm，请先安装 Node.js 18+"; exit 1; }
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "未找到 node"; exit 1; }

if [[ ! -d vendor ]]; then
  echo "安装 PHP 依赖…"
  "$COMPOSER" install --no-interaction --prefer-dist
fi

if [[ ! -d frontend/node_modules ]]; then
  echo "安装前端依赖…"
  ( cd frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund )
fi

[[ -f .env ]] || cp .env.example .env
# 默认使用 SQLite
sed -i.bak 's/^DB_CONNECTION=.*/DB_CONNECTION=sqlite/' .env 2>/dev/null || true
sed -i.bak 's/^DB_DATABASE=.*/# DB_DATABASE=/' .env 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f .env.bak

: > database/database.sqlite
"$PHP" artisan key:generate --force 2>/dev/null || true
"$PHP" artisan migrate --force
"$PHP" artisan db:seed --force
[[ -e public/storage ]] || "$PHP" artisan storage:link

echo
echo "初始化完成。执行 bin/dev.sh 一键启动前后端。"

# 工地出场车辆洗轮与泥污复查系统（本地版）

门岗核对出场车辆是否洗净的业务系统。同一辆车每次出场都生成**独立出场单**，
每次检查都必须在当次出场单上留下**当轮拍摄的车轮、车身照片与结论**；
不合格退回洗轮区，复洗后在**原单上增加一轮检查**。只有**本次最后一轮检查合格**
才能向闸机发送放行指令。

- 后端：PHP 8.3 + Laravel 12（Eloquent / Sanctum token 认证）
- 前端：React 18 + Vite + React Router（纯手写，无 UI 库）
- 数据库：SQLite（`database/database.sqlite`）
- 车牌识别、闸机接口：本地模拟服务（`App\Services\LprService`、`App\Services\GateService`）
- 照片：保存在本地 `storage/app/public/inspection-photos/`，以文件 sha256 指纹防复用

## 一键启动

```bash
bin/setup.sh   # 首次：安装依赖、初始化 SQLite、写入演示账号
bin/dev.sh     # 启动后端 http://127.0.0.1:8000 与前端 http://127.0.0.1:5173
```

打开 http://127.0.0.1:5173 ，演示账号（密码均为 `password`）：

| 账号 | 角色 | 权限 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clerk@site.local` | 普通检查人员（李录入） | 建单、上传各轮检查照片；**不能人工放行** |
| `supervisor@site.local` | 值班员（王值班） | 全部录入权限 + **人工放行（必须填写原因）** |

> 无系统 PHP 时，`bin/setup.sh`/`bin/dev.sh` 会自动使用仓库 `.tools/php` 静态二进制
> （需自备，见文末“无 root 环境工具链”）。

## 业务流程与关键规则

1. **登记出场单**：上传相机抓拍照 → 本地模拟车牌识别。识别结果（成功/失败、置信度、
   原始返回 JSON、请求号）原样落库；识别失败时可人工登记车牌，**原始识别结果不被覆盖**。
   可勾选“模拟识别失败”联调。
2. **第 1 轮检查（初次）**：必须同时上传当次车轮、车身照片，选择合格/不合格。
3. **不合格 → 退回复洗**：车辆复洗后在**同一张出场单**上“增加一轮检查”（第 2、3…轮），
   初次不合格照片与所有复洗记录全部保留，门岗页面按轮次顺序展示。
4. **放行**：
   - 正常放行：**仅当最后一轮检查合格**时按钮可用；复洗仍不合格一律拒绝（HTTP 422）。
   - 人工放行：仅值班员账号可见入口，且必须填写原因；普通人员直接调 API 也会被拒绝（403）。
   - 放行调用模拟闸机接口，记录指令号与应答，出场单锁定，不能再补检查或重复放行。
5. **禁止旧照片顶替**：服务端对每张上传照片计算 sha256 并做**全局唯一约束**
   （`inspection_photos.file_hash` UNIQUE + 提交前查询双重校验）。
   无论是同一单的历史轮次，还是同一辆车以前的出场单，字节相同的照片一律拒绝提交。

## 主要 API（均在 `/api` 前缀下，除登录外需 `Authorization: Bearer <token>`）

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/auth/login` | 登录获取 token |
| POST | `/gate-passes` | multipart：`lpr_image`、`simulate_failure`、`manual_plate` 等，建单并识别 |
| GET | `/gate-passes` / `/gate-passes/{id}` | 列表（带末轮摘要）/ 详情（含全部轮次、照片、放行记录） |
| POST | `/gate-passes/{id}/manual-plate` | 识别失败后人工登记车牌（原结果保留） |
| POST | `/gate-passes/{id}/inspections` | multipart：`result`、`wheel_photo`、`body_photo`、`finding`，新增一轮检查 |
| POST | `/gate-passes/{id}/release` | `{"type":"normal"}` 或 `{"type":"manual","reason":"…"}` |

业务错误统一返回 `422 {"message", "error_code"}`，权限错误返回 `403`。
错误码：`LATEST_ROUND_NOT_QUALIFIED`、`PHOTO_ALREADY_USED`、`PHOTO_DUPLICATE_IN_ROUND`、
`FORBIDDEN`、`MANUAL_REASON_REQUIRED`、`PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED`、`NO_INSPECTION` 等。

## 自动测试

```bash
.tools/php artisan test          # PHPUnit Feature 测试（4 个用例 / 37 断言）
node tests/smoke-api.cjs         # 端到端 HTTP 冒烟（需先 bin/dev.sh 起后端，16 项检查）
```

重点覆盖的三类拦截：

- **复洗仍不合格**：连续两轮不合格时正常放行返回 422，闸机无任何放行记录，照片全保留；
- **引用旧照片**：同单旧轮次、跨出场单复用照片均返回 422 `PHOTO_ALREADY_USED`，轮次不落库；
- **无权限人工放行**：普通人员返回 403，值班员不填原因返回 422，均不产生闸机指令。

另含：识别失败保留原始返回 + 人工登记、合格放行成功、重复放行拒绝等。

## 目录结构（业务部分）

```
app/
  Models/            GatePass / Inspection / InspectionPhoto / GateRelease / User
  Services/
    LprService.php   车牌识别本地模拟（按图片哈希派生稳定车牌；可模拟失败）
    GateService.php  闸机接口本地模拟（返回指令号与应答 JSON）
    GatePassService.php  全部业务强校验集中在此（轮次、照片指纹、放行权限）
  Http/Controllers/Api/  AuthController、GatePassController
  Http/Requests/     建单/检查/放行的表单校验（每轮强制必传两类照片）
  Http/Resources/    出场单按轮次序列化输出
  Exceptions/GatePassRuleException.php  业务规则异常 → 422 + 错误码
database/migrations/ gate_passes、inspections、inspection_photos、gate_releases 等
frontend/src/pages/  LoginPage / PassListPage / PassDetailPage
tests/Feature/GatePassFlowTest.php
tests/smoke-api.cjs
```

## 无 root 环境工具链

仓库 `.tools/`（已 gitignore）可放用户态工具，脚本会自动识别：

- `.tools/php`：静态 PHP 8.3 CLI（含 pdo_sqlite、gd、mbstring 等）
- `.tools/composer.phar` + `.tools/composer`（包装脚本）

若环境网络对静态 PHP 的 TLS 不兼容，`.tools/proxy/` 内附带了一个 Node 本地
MITM 代理脚本（仅供本机开发安装依赖使用）。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 首次环境准备：安装 PHP/Node 依赖、初始化 SQLite 数据库。
# 用法：bin/setup.sh
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

if [[ -x "$ROOT/.tools/php" ]]; then
  PHP="$ROOT/.tools/php"
  COMPOSER="$ROOT/.tools/composer"
else
  PHP="$(command -v php)"
  COMPOSER="$(command -v composer)"
fi
echo "PHP: $($PHP -v | head -1)"

command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "未找到 npm，请先安装 Node.js 18+"; exit 1; }
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "未找到 node"; exit 1; }

if [[ ! -d vendor ]]; then
  echo "安装 PHP 依赖…"
  "$COMPOSER" install --no-interaction --prefer-dist
fi

if [[ ! -d frontend/node_modules ]]; then
  echo "安装前端依赖…"
  ( cd frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund )
fi

[[ -f .env ]] || cp .env.example .env
# 默认使用 SQLite
sed -i.bak 's/^DB_CONNECTION=.*/DB_CONNECTION=sqlite/' .env 2>/dev/null || true
sed -i.bak 's/^DB_DATABASE=.*/# DB_DATABASE=/' .env 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f .env.bak

: > database/database.sqlite
"$PHP" artisan key:generate --force 2>/dev/null || true
"$PHP" artisan migrate --force
"$PHP" artisan db:seed --force
[[ -e public/storage ]] || "$PHP" artisan storage:link

echo
echo "初始化完成。执行 bin/dev.sh 一键启动前后端。"

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Exceptions\GatePassRuleException;
use App\Models\GatePass;
use App\Models\GateRelease;
use App\Models\Inspection;
use App\Models\InspectionPhoto;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\AccessDeniedHttpException;

class GatePassService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly LprService $lpr,
        private readonly GateService $gate,
    ) {}

    /**
     * 登记一张新的出场单并调用本地车牌识别。
     * 识别结果（成功或失败）原样留存；识别失败时可同时/事后人工登记车牌。
     */
    public function createPass(
        User $operator,
        ?UploadedFile $lprImage,
        bool $simulateRecognitionFailure,
        ?string $manualPlate,
        ?string $driverName,
        ?string $remark,
    ): GatePass {
        $recognition = $this->lpr->recognize(
            $lprImage?->getPathname(),
            $lprImage?->getClientOriginalName(),
            $simulateRecognitionFailure,
        );

        $failed = $recognition['status'] === 'failed';

        if (! $failed && $manualPlate !== null && trim($manualPlate) !== '') {
            // 识别成功时不需要人工登记，避免混淆
            $manualPlate = null;
        }

        return GatePass::create([
            'plate_number' => $failed ? null : $recognition['plate'],
            'recognition_status' => $recognition['status'],
            'recognized_text' => $recognition['plate'],
            'recognition_confidence' => $recognition['confidence'],
            'recognition_raw' => $recognition['raw'],
            'manual_plate_number' => $failed ? $this->normalizePlate($manualPlate) : null,
            'manual_entered_by' => ($failed && $manualPlate) ? $operator->id : null,
            'driver_name' => $driverName,
            'remark' => $remark,
            'status' => GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            'created_by' => $operator->id,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * 识别失败后补录车牌。原始识别结果始终保留，不做任何覆盖。
     */
    public function registerManualPlate(User $operator, GatePass $pass, string $plate): GatePass
    {
        if ($pass->recognition_status !== 'failed') {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('车牌识别成功，无需人工登记', 'MANUAL_PLATE_NOT_ALLOWED');
        }

        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单已放行，不能再修改车牌', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        $pass->update([
            'manual_plate_number' => $this->normalizePlate($plate),
            'manual_entered_by' => $operator->id,
        ]);

        return $pass->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * 在原出场单上增加一轮检查（初次检查 / 复洗后复查）。
     *
     * 每一轮都必须随请求重新上传当次拍摄的车轮、车身照片：
     * - 系统不提供"引用历史照片"的入口；
     * - 服务端对文件 sha256 做全局唯一校验，任何与历史出场单或历史轮次字节相同的
     *   照片一律拒绝，防止用以前出场的照片顶替本次检查。
     */
    public function addInspection(
        User $inspector,
        GatePass $pass,
        string $result,
        ?string $finding,
        UploadedFile $wheelPhoto,
        UploadedFile $bodyPhoto,
    ): Inspection {
        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单已放行，不能再增加检查轮次', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        if (! in_array($result, [Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED, Inspection::RESULT_UNQUALIFIED], true)) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('检查结果取值非法', 'INVALID_RESULT');
        }

        $wheelHash = hash_file('sha256', $wheelPhoto->getPathname());
        $bodyHash = hash_file('sha256', $bodyPhoto->getPathname());

        if ($wheelHash === $bodyHash) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('车轮照片与车身照片不能是同一张图片', 'PHOTO_DUPLICATE_IN_ROUND');
        }

        $used = InspectionPhoto::whereIn('file_hash', [$wheelHash, $bodyHash])
            ->with('inspection:id,gate_pass_id,round')
            ->get();

        if ($used->isNotEmpty()) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException(
                '检测到上传的照片已在历史出场检查中使用，必须使用本次当场拍摄的照片',
                'PHOTO_ALREADY_USED',
            );
        }

        $round = ((int) $pass->inspections()->max('round')) + 1;

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($inspector, $pass, $result, $finding, $wheelPhoto, $bodyPhoto, $wheelHash, $bodyHash, $round) {
            $inspection = $pass->inspections()->create([
                'round' => $round,
                'result' => $result,
                'finding' => $finding,
                'inspected_by' => $inspector->id,
                'inspected_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $this->storePhoto($inspection, InspectionPhoto::VIEW_WHEEL, $wheelPhoto, $wheelHash, $inspector);
            $this->storePhoto($inspection, InspectionPhoto::VIEW_BODY, $bodyPhoto, $bodyHash, $inspector);

            // 只有最新一轮的结论决定出场单状态；以前轮次即使合格也不算数
            $pass->update([
                'status' => $result === Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED
                    ? GatePass::STATUS_PASSED
                    : GatePass::STATUS_PENDING,
            ]);

            return $inspection->load('photos', 'inspector:id,name');
        });
    }

    private function storePhoto(Inspection $inspection, string $viewType, UploadedFile $file, string $hash, User $uploader): void
    {
        $directory = sprintf('inspection-photos/%d/round-%d', $inspection->gate_pass_id, $inspection->round);
        $extension = $file->getClientOriginalExtension() ?: 'jpg';
        $name = sprintf('%s-%s.%s', $viewType, substr($hash, 0, 16), $extension);

        $path = $file->storeAs($directory, $name, 'public');

        // 唯一索引兜底：并发请求同时通过前置哈希查询时，INSERT 会在这里冲突
        try {
            InspectionPhoto::create([
                'inspection_id' => $inspection->id,
                'view_type' => $viewType,
                'file_path' => $path,
                'original_name' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                'file_size' => $file->getSize(),
                'file_hash' => $hash,
                'uploaded_by' => $uploader->id,
            ]);
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException(
                '检测到上传的照片已在历史出场检查中使用，必须使用本次当场拍摄的照片',
                'PHOTO_ALREADY_USED',
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * 下发放行指令。
     *
     * 正常放行：本次出场单最后一轮检查必须合格（复洗后仍不合格直接拒绝）。
     * 人工放行：仅值班员可操作，且必须填写原因；普通录入人员抛出 403。
     */
    public function release(User $operator, GatePass $pass, string $type, ?string $reason): GateRelease
    {
        if ($pass->status === GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED) {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('该出场单已发送过放行指令，请勿重复放行', 'PASS_ALREADY_RELEASED');
        }

        $latest = $pass->inspections()->reorder()->orderByDesc('round')->first();

        if ($type === GateRelease::TYPE_NORMAL) {
            if ($latest === null) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单尚无任何检查记录，不允许放行', 'NO_INSPECTION');
            }
            if ($latest->result !== Inspection::RESULT_QUALIFIED) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException(
                    "第 {$latest->round} 轮检查（最后一轮）结论为不合格，请退回洗轮区复洗后重新检查",
                    'LATEST_ROUND_NOT_QUALIFIED',
                );
            }
        } elseif ($type === GateRelease::TYPE_MANUAL) {
            // 权限第一优先：普通录入人员拿不到人工放行入口，强行调用同样拒绝
            if (! $operator->isSupervisor()) {
                throw new AccessDeniedHttpException('只有值班员可以执行人工放行');
            }
            if ($latest === null) {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('出场单尚无任何检查记录，不允许人工放行', 'NO_INSPECTION');
            }
            if (trim((string) $reason) === '') {
                throw new GatePassRuleException('人工放行必须填写原因', 'MANUAL_REASON_REQUIRED');
            }
        } else {
            throw new GatePassRuleException('放行类型非法', 'INVALID_RELEASE_TYPE');
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($operator, $pass, $type, $reason, $latest) {
            $gate = $this->gate->open($pass);

            $release = GateRelease::create([
                'gate_pass_id' => $pass->id,
                'release_type' => $type,
                'released_by' => $operator->id,
                'reason' => $type === GateRelease::TYPE_MANUAL ? trim((string) $reason) : null,
                'gate_command_id' => $gate['command_id'],
                'gate_response_code' => $gate['code'],
                'gate_response_raw' => $gate['raw'],
                'released_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $pass->update(['status' => GatePass::STATUS_RELEASED]);

content.text:
系统已完整建成并通过全部验证。前后端目前正在运行：**http://127.0.0.1:5173**

## 已交付内容

**技术栈**：Laravel 12（PHP 8.3 + Eloquent + Sanctum）+ React 18/Vite + SQLite，车牌识别与闸机均为本地模拟服务，照片存本地磁盘。

**一键命令**：
- `bin/setup.sh` — 首次初始化（装依赖、建 SQLite、写演示账号）
- `bin/dev.sh` — 一条命令同时拉起后端 `:8000` 和前端 `:5173`（当前已在运行）

演示账号（密码均为 `password`）：`clerk@site.local`（普通检查人员）、`supervisor@site.local`（值班员）。

## 三个重点拦截场景的实现与验证

| 场景 | 后端强制点 | 实测结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **复洗仍不合格** | 放行只认真实最后一轮（`reorder()->orderByDesc('round')`），不合格抛 `LATEST_ROUND_NOT_QUALIFIED`；初检与每轮复洗记录、照片全部保留 | 连续两轮不合格放行均 **422**，闸机零记录，2 轮 ×2 张照片仍在 ✓ |
| **引用旧照片** | 每轮必须随请求重新上传车轮+车身照片；服务端算 sha256，提交前查重 + `file_hash` 全局 UNIQUE 索引兜底，跨轮次、跨出场单都拦 | 同单复用、同一辆车再次出场复用均 **422 PHOTO_ALREADY_USED**，轮次不落库 ✓ |
| **无权限人工放行** | 人工放行先判 `role=supervisor`（普通人员直接调 API 也 **403**），且原因必填；合格单不允许走人工通道 | 录入员 **403**、值班员不填原因 **422**，值班员填原因后成功并留档 ✓ |

另覆盖：识别失败时原始返回（错误码/请求号/图片哈希）原样保留、可事后人工登记车牌不覆盖原结果；合格放行成功、重复放行拒绝、已放行单锁定等。共 **PHPUnit 4 用例 37 断言 + 端到端冒烟 16 项全部通过**（含经 Vite 代理的真实 multipart 上传）。

**门岗页面**：出场单详情严格按第 1 轮、第 2 轮…顺序展示照片与合格/不合格结论，不合格轮次标红"退回洗轮区"；最后一轮不合格时正常放行按钮锁定并红字提示，人工放行入口仅值班员可见、弹窗强制填写原因。

一点环境说明：沙箱无 root 且系统未装 PHP，我在 `.tools/`（已 gitignore）放了静态 PHP 8.3 和 Composer，启动脚本会自动识别；静态 PHP 的 TLS 被沙箱透明代理拦截，故附带了一个仅本机装依赖用的 Node MITM 代理（`.tools/proxy/`），业务运行不依赖它。
